datafield.subfield:
- student group book from "Book as Environment" Workshop / c. Jan '79. Participants include Alec Dann, Jamie Hart, Bob Gilson, Lee Carmical, Nancy Weaver, Lee Silverman, Linn Underhill, Pat Weygint, Adrienne May, and Nancy from Wilkes-Barre.
Part A Stapled book - xerox, collage, handwriting, diagrams. Self-reflective book recording and participating in the process of a group agreement and disagreement in forming a book.
Part B Loose pages from class "notebook" - handwritten notes from participants serving as source material for final Group Book (by Book Group)
various / group book by book group
